It specializes in delivery, and if you look for it on the map, it is an actual operating place.
On the second floor, there is the famous kimchi stew Hongdae branch that you can eat twice and the 30-year immortal chicken feet Hongdae branch.

By cleverly mixing up the names, only Kimchi Jjim, a delivery app (Baemin), has been operating as a Hongdae branch for 30 years (according to Baemin information, all three locations had the same owner's name and address).

I received a message in the morning and checked to find that my review had been permanently deleted. I tried to find out what was going on, but I couldn't respond because I didn't see the message from Baemin last month, so it was permanently deleted. I did a review of the facts along with the photos, but the owner said he didn't like the rating and asked me to delete it haha.

I wondered why this meal was delivered with a rating of 5 stars.
Was it a company that manipulated star ratings?

I am uploading the reviews I wrote at the time as well as reviews written by other people. Strangely enough, the only thing with a low star rating is the recent reviews. I don't think there are any reviews that have been around for more than a month because they've all been deleted. I wonder if those reviews will remain the same next week or next month. reviews.text:
It is a large cafe where a cute bear lives.

With the concept of a bear, everything from the interior of the store to props and desserts was designed to resemble a bear.

Looking at the colorful interior and cute desserts makes me smile without even realizing it.

However, it is not at all a cafe that is decorated to look pretty. Cute but delicious desserts and unique drinks are available.

📌Cherry Jubilee Cream
A cute bear filled with cherry cream puffs. It is a cream puff bread that does not have a strong cherry flavor, but has a soft creamy taste.
Anyone can eat it without any likes or dislikes.

📌Kaya Butter Scone
The non-dry scones are filled with butter and kaya jam.
The kaya jam flavor is not strong, but the butter and scones are already delicious enough.

📌Kakaos More Cookies
It is a cookie with a brownie-like texture.
It was a little too sweet for my taste.
Recommended if you like sweet things

📌Earl Gray Cake
This cake is truly full of Earl Gray flavor. Everything from the sheets to the cream seems to have Earl Gray in it.

There is so much color in the cake that it seems like it will taste strange, but it doesn't taste like that at all.
The cake is large and has Earl Gray flavor, so I highly recommend it.

📌Cream Melon Soda
Vanilla ice cream was added to melon soda. It tastes like melonade with a little sweetness added, and is a unique menu item that cannot be found anywhere else.

📌Milk Tea Latte
It is a milk tea that is not too sweet and has a strong milk tea taste.
Good to eat with dessert.

The desserts and drinks are good, but the real thing about this place is the interior. Interior points and props are placed throughout the interior to make you want to take pictures over and over again.

The space is very large, so you don't have to worry about waiting. Recommended if you are looking for a date spot.

reviews.text: There aren't many places where you can drink coffee early on weekday mornings, but it's nice to work on your laptop while listening to good music on a terrace in a quiet residential area. A new morning bagel coffee set has also been added to the menu, so I have to give it a try. I like basking in the sun and feeling the breeze, so I like the many outdoor tables here. However, when I came in the afternoon, I saw that most of the customers were smoking at the outdoor tables. As a non-smoker, it's a little unpleasant, but for smokers, it's heaven. Where can you smoke so openly and comfortably these days? Multiple parking spaces are available in the building, and considering the characteristics of the Hongdae area, it is a great advantage to be able to park for free and meet people or drink coffee. I should say it's a backyard, but there's another terrace on one side with a green carpet that looks like grass, and it's surrounded by a white fence and surrounded by trees, making it feel like you're in a forest. That's probably why camping chairs and tables were placed here. It's great to sit around and chat with people, but the table is too low for someone like me who drinks coffee and works alone. Even though he is occupying the entire space by himself, he is noticeable. They also sell draft and bottled beer, and the atmosphere looks very nice as you see a group of people drinking beer in the dim light in the evening. The coffee is relatively inexpensive, and the blend here suits my taste very well. I don't know if it's a place worth finding from far away, but if you're looking for a small cafe with a nice atmosphere in Hongdae, this might be a good place.

reviews.author: Pretty girl genius
reviews.text:
It's a really old cafe. In the past, when there was only Disco Planet near my house, I went there every day. 50 seconds walk. Now, there are cafes within a 10-second walk away, so I go 10 seconds away... you lazy ningen...
Still, it's a cafe I visit often.

Because it is a roastery, you can smell the beans being roasted every day. It is a very cost-effective cafe. There is even a VIP system, so customers who purchase more than a certain amount around the time of opening become VIPs and are issued a card and receive a 20% discount, making it cheaper.

It is better for use by 2 or more people rather than 1 person. There are many spacious seats. A lot of office workers come and go during lunch time. There is also quite a lot of takeout.

There is a cat named Unni. I've seen him since I first adopted him, and he's grown a lot. The cafe's mascot:) It's a really gentle cat.

Since this place is frequently rented out, business hours can vary from time to time.

They only sell drinks, no food or appetizers.
The coffee menu is all delicious, especially the cold brew, which is good and cheap. If you buy a bottle of cold brew for 6,000 won, you get a cup of cold brew together.

They sell coffee beans and various goods together.
The owner is probably a judge of some kind of coffee roasting competition.
